svg.title: Graph points with no start place
svg.desc: 19 by 19 grid of graph points from -9 to 9 on each axis. 310 points lead to a place, 51 do not: 49 in the four corners plus (0, 3) and (5, 7).
svg.text: Graph points with no start place
Where yesterday's graph point sends tomorrow's dream

A dream after such a day starts on stage 1, at one of its 3 spawn points.
